title: Grays' moon base

tellings.quote: The grays who have a base on the moon come and go at any time they want.

plain: Small grey beings, known as grays, have a base on the Moon and "come and go at any time they want," according to Charles Hall. Hall says he spent three years at a Nevada military site with tall white aliens, and he passes this on as part of what he says he learned there, which would mean more than one kind of visitor is coming and going near Earth.
